verify:full.gate: every T0 + T1 + T2 task passes

verify:selftest.gate: every registered gate returns non-zero with one planted defect

audit:secrets.gate: 0 findings across every tracked and untracked-not-ignored file

typecheck.gate: 0 type errors across all 4 tsc projects

audit:integrity.gate: 0 unledgered markers, 0 non-ledgerable markers, 0 expired or stale ledger entries

audit:ratchet.gate: no regression in the cheap fields: suppressions, scan fingerprints, registered task list

audit:ratchet:full.gate: no regression in any measured field, including coverage denominators and the measured file set

build.gate: shared, server and client build with exit 0

test:unit.gate: all pass; shared and client coverage thresholds hold

test:integration.gate: all pass against a real mongod; server coverage thresholds hold

test:security.gate: the route table matches the real router stack, and every id-taking route refuses a non-owner without touching the target

test:observability.gate: no request value, audit row or production error body carries a secret, and a 5xx body is redacted to its status text

test:property.gate: every property holds in BOTH timezones: the crypto round-trip and its fresh IV, the five schemas as fixed points, combineExpiry across a fall-back DST repeated hour, the entropy metrics monotonic, deliveryNotes unrendered, and the folder forest acyclic and within the nesting cap under any sequence of operations

audit:deps.gate: 0 production advisories at moderate or above

audit:secrets:full.gate: 0 findings across the working tree AND every blob in git history

deadcode.gate: 0 unused files, exports, types or dependencies; duplication at or below the committed ceiling

audit:config.gate: 0 error-level findings from actionlint, hadolint and spectral

audit:licenses.gate: every production dependency carries an allowlisted licence; 0 copyleft

audit:image.gate: all 4 images build; nginx -t passes; compose config resolves; 0 fixable HIGH/CRITICAL

deferred.test:api: No separable command exists today. Every supertest suite lives beside the unit suites in packages/server/tests/*.test.ts, so the only ways to register it would be a committed test filter (a non-ledgerable TEST-FILTER under the integrity doctrine) or a second, duplicate invocation of the 125-second server suite that would report false independence. test:integration runs those suites today. Register test:api once the API suites move under their own directory.
